YOUR LITTLE WORLD

Privacy, simply.

Last updated: 14 October 2026

Your pet stays on your device.

The mobile web app stores your chosen owner name, pet name, progress and preferences in your browser’s local storage. The Windows app stores them in a local save file. We have not added analytics, advertising, or a cloud account system to either app.

Your names are for your pet.

Use a nickname if you like. The optional website name preview passes your chosen names to the app in the page URL; those values may appear in your browser history and hosting access logs. You can instead enter names directly inside the app.

Backups are yours to keep.

Export creates a JSON file on your device. Import reads the file locally and replaces your mobile pet only after confirmation. Clearing browser storage can erase the pet. Desktop and mobile do not sync automatically.

The website needs hosting.

The hosting provider processes ordinary connection information to deliver this site, and private preview access may require a hosting sign-in. The mobile app caches its files for offline use after a successful first visit.
